informative_completion_stress.interpretation: Outcome-related completion makes complete-case mismatch look about five times smaller than latent planned-slot mismatch in this synthetic stress. Missing-as-one does not estimate complete-case mismatch; it intentionally targets the composite failure-or-mismatch endpoint and remains conservative for the coherent latent bounded mismatch in this example.

scope_guards: The fail-closed endpoint intentionally counts operational no-result as unreliability; it is not a generic missing-data estimator.
The latent forced-completion upper-bound interpretation requires a coherent bounded latent outcome for every interrupted slot.
The 200k-slot experiment is synthetic validation of selection behavior, not a production failure-rate measurement.
Outer confidence-sequence validity remains a separate contract; this validation covers endpoint/state-machine semantics only.
